title: Hamletworks (hamletworks.org): The Enfolded Hamlet and Hamlet textual notes
institution: Bernice W. Kliman (Nassau Community College, SUNY) and the hamletworks.org editors; webmaster Jeffery Triggs
author: William Shakespeare
notes: Research site for Shakespeare's Hamlet. It offers the 'Enfolded Hamlet' (Bernice Kliman, 1996) as linked texts of the Second Quarto (1604/5) and the First Folio (1623) in exact original spelling, a modern enfolded text, line-by-line commentary and textual notes, and diplomatic versions of the First Quarto (1603) and Sixth Quarto as PDF/DjVu files, plus later editions and promptbooks. The domain redirects to a different host name (server-66-113-234-189.da.direct). The introduction page was last modified in February 2025. Copyright is held by the editors; reading is free. The counts cover the Q2 and F1 transcriptions only, since the Q1 and Q6 versions exist only as PDF or DjVu images. Corpus statistics (text and word counts) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this resource in October 2026, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
